_note: PROVISIONAL classification of BOQ lines, derived from the approved drawings (Kemari, Korangi, KSU, Murtiba) and the five BOQs. Not from the client's instruction file, which has no such rules (open question Q1). Rules are tried in order; the first whose conditions all match wins. Conditions are case-insensitive regular expressions searched in the named field. 'description' is searched in the headline only (the first 70 characters), because BOQ descriptions often carry pages of spec text that mention cables, warranties and modules; 'description_full' searches all of it. A line that matches nothing gets the default bucket and is reported as 'by default'.

rules.reason: Certificates and documents are not equipment.
Spares are stock, not part of the architecture.
A workstation specified inside a materials section.
Shown in the networking layer; its 'patch cords' are not a separate cable line.
A switch is a device even when the line says '& cable'. 'Switch module' and 'switchover' are rack parts and are not caught.
Package line covering supply and works.
Engineering work. An 'Engineering Laptop' has unit pcs and is not caught.
